unit_cn: Unit 4 Amazing Art 神奇的艺术
source: 外研社(新标准)必修三 Unit 4 词表(p38-47 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、Amazing Art 艺术主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The guide stood at the door to greet the visitors to the art show.
words.example_cn: 导览员站在门口迎接来看艺术展的参观者。

words.meaning_cn: 广播节目;电视节目;播送
words.example_en: Zack made a live broadcast from inside the famous Louvre Museum.
words.example_cn: 扎克从著名的卢浮宫内做了一场现场直播。

words.phrase_en: at the top of the stairs
words.example_en: The huge statue stands at the top of the stone stairs.
words.example_cn: 那座巨大的雕像立在石阶的顶端。

words.example_en: Just get a load of that magnificent sculpture over there!
words.example_cn: 快看那边那座宏伟的雕塑!

words.example_en: The winged statue seems to celebrate the result of an ancient battle.
words.example_cn: 那座带翅膀的雕像仿佛在庆祝一场古代战役的胜利。

words.example_en: Look at how the stone dress is being folded by the wind.
words.example_cn: 看那石雕的裙子被风吹得折叠起来的样子。

words.example_en: The skill of the sculptor who made this work is just incredible.
words.example_cn: 创作这件作品的雕塑家的技艺令人惊叹。

words.example_en: A huge sculpture of a winged lady stands above the stairs.
words.example_cn: 一座带翅膀女子的巨大雕塑矗立在楼梯之上。

words.example_en: Rembrandt painted this self-portrait about four hundred years ago.
words.example_cn: 伦勃朗大约在四百年前画了这幅自画像。

words.example_en: Perhaps a self-portrait was the artist's way of taking a selfie.
words.example_cn: 也许自画像就是那位艺术家自拍的方式。

words.example_en: We saw a breathtaking exhibition of Chinese porcelain at the festival.
words.example_cn: 我们在艺术节上看了一场令人惊叹的中国瓷器展。

words.example_en: The cleaners in the gallery threw away the artwork by mistake.
words.example_cn: 美术馆的清洁工误把那件艺术品扔掉了。

words.example_en: The Louvre is full of some of the most amazing treasures on Earth.
words.example_cn: 卢浮宫里满是地球上最令人惊叹的一些珍宝。

words.example_en: Night-Shining White is regarded as Han Gan's greatest masterpiece.
words.example_cn: 《照夜白》被视为韩干最伟大的杰作。

words.example_en: Original buildings are being built in every neighbourhood of the city.
words.example_cn: 城市的每个街区都在建造别具一格的建筑。

words.example_en: Some people find graffiti too random, but I love its bright colours.
words.example_cn: 有些人觉得涂鸦太随意,但我喜欢它鲜艳的色彩。

words.example_en: A woman used a needle and thread to do some lovely embroidery.
words.example_cn: 一位女子用针线绣出了漂亮的刺绣。

words.example_en: The old man showed me how a stone seal is carved and stamped.
words.example_cn: 那位老人给我演示了石印章如何被刻制并盖印。

words.example_en: An old man was writing Chinese calligraphy in a free and elegant style.
words.example_cn: 一位老人正以自由而优雅的笔法书写中国书法。

words.example_en: I bought a blue porcelain cup and saucer at the art festival.
words.example_cn: 我在艺术节上买了一只蓝色的瓷杯和茶碟。

words.example_en: At each stand, artists could demonstrate their skills to the visitors.
words.example_cn: 在每个展位上,艺术家都能向参观者示范他们的技艺。

words.example_en: The blue bowl vividly showed a dragon playing with a ball.
words.example_cn: 那只青花碗生动地描绘了一条龙戏珠的图案。

words.example_en: She used a needle and some thread to make a tiny flower.
words.example_cn: 她用针和线绣出了一朵小花。

words.example_en: His calligraphy was so free and elegant that everyone admired it.
words.example_cn: 他的书法自由又优雅,人人都很赞赏。

words.example_en: Chinese characters are carved into small squares of stone.
words.example_cn: 汉字被刻进一小块块的石头里。

words.meaning_cn: 当代的;现代的;同时代的
words.example_en: Contemporary art often raises the question, "Is it really art?"
words.example_cn: 当代艺术常常引出一个问题:“这真的是艺术吗?”

words.example_en: The cleaners mistook the pile of cigarette ends for rubbish.
words.example_cn: 清洁工把那堆烟头当成了垃圾。

words.example_en: Some people say contemporary art lacks skill and real meaning.
words.example_cn: 有些人说当代艺术缺乏技巧和真正的内涵。

words.example_en: Others argue that such art can stimulate new discussions.
words.example_cn: 另一些人则认为这类艺术能激发新的讨论。

words.example_en: What a magnificent horse the painter has shown in this work!
words.example_cn: 画家在这幅作品中画出了一匹多么壮美的马啊!

words.example_en: The painted horse seems to bare its teeth with great power.
words.example_cn: 画中的马仿佛龇着牙,充满力量。

words.example_en: We can almost feel the power in the horse's kicking hooves.
words.example_cn: 我们几乎能感受到那马蹄踢动时的力量。

words.example_en: Young Han Gan had to work in a local wine shop to help his family.
words.example_cn: 年轻的韩干不得不在当地一家酒坊干活以补贴家用。

words.example_en: Han Gan used a stick to draw pictures in the dirt by the gate.
words.example_cn: 韩干用一根树枝在门边的泥土上画画。

words.example_en: Wang Wei decided to sponsor the young man to study painting.
words.example_cn: 王维决定资助这位年轻人去学画。

words.example_en: Han Gan was finally chosen to serve the emperor in the royal palace.
words.example_cn: 韩干最终被选中在皇宫中侍奉皇帝。

words.example_en: The Tang emperors were very fond of horses.
words.example_cn: 唐代的皇帝们非常喜爱马。

words.example_en: Han Gan was a frequent visitor to the royal stables.
words.example_cn: 韩干是皇家马厩的常客。

words.example_en: "I have my own teachers, Your Majesty," the artist replied.
words.example_cn: “陛下,我有自己的老师,”这位画家答道。

words.example_en: People said that Han Gan's horses could gallop off the paper.
words.example_cn: 人们说韩干画的马仿佛能从纸上飞奔出来。

words.example_en: Van Gogh's painting shows yellow sunflowers in a vase.
words.example_cn: 梵高的这幅画描绘了花瓶里的黄色向日葵。

words.example_en: This painting is done mostly in three shades of yellow.
words.example_cn: 这幅画主要由三种深浅不同的黄色绘成。

words.meaning_cn: (色彩的)浓淡;深浅;色度;阴凉处
words.example_en: The colours range from bright yellows to brownish shades.
words.example_cn: 色彩从明黄渐变到带褐的深浅色调。

words.meaning_cn: 灵感;启发;鼓舞人心的人(或事物)
words.example_en: The real horses gave Han Gan plenty of inspiration for his art.
words.example_cn: 真实的马给了韩干充足的创作灵感。

words.example_en: Su Shi expressed his admiration for Han Gan as a master painter.
words.example_cn: 苏轼表达了对画马大师韩干的钦佩。

words.meaning_cn: 注意;仔细看(表示惊讶或羡慕)
words.example_en: Get a load of that winged statue above the stairs!
words.example_cn: 瞧瞧楼梯上方那座带翅膀的雕像!

words.example_en: In seal cutting, names are carved into small squares of stone.
words.example_cn: 在篆刻中,人名被刻进一小块块的石头里。

words.example_en: It is wonderful to be fond of art and to visit galleries often.
words.example_cn: 喜爱艺术、常去看画展是件很美好的事。
